thread:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert — embedder-service latency spike in us-west-2. Pager fired for oncall @alex. Alert: <https://alerts.redwood/incidents/2422223330>

alex: Acked. Jumping on it now. /incident ack 2422223330

casey: Seeing KV cache pressure and a small surge of long-tail seqs. Scaling pool +2 instances, enabling fallback model variant (embedder-v1-small).

samir: Customer impact quick note: ~12% requests >1s, several 504s for a subset of dedicated tenants (cust:acme, cust:bright). Raising to P1 for customer comms?

priya: Thanks. Can we confirm scope before comms? Which tenants hit and ETA to mitigation?

alex: ETA ~8-12m with scale + fallback. I'll post once latency curve improves. Owning immediate mitigation.

casey: Mitigation applied: autoscale +2 and fallback enabled. KPIs starting to normalize, P99 down from 2.8s -> 620ms. Rolling evict on KV to free memory.

samir: Noted. Logging shows cache churn around TTL boundary after last deploy. I suspect recent TTL change exposed this pattern. Will capture logs and sample traces.

priya: If P99 is back under SLO and no new 504s, we can send initial note to affected customers. Alex can you draft a short status?

alex: Drafted customer note, will send once we hold for 30m and confirm stability.

casey: Post-mitigation actions proposed (quick sizing):
1) Reproduce TTL churn in staging and add regression test — size: small (1d) — owner: casey
2) Restore safe TTL default and add config guard — size: small (2d) — owner: samir
3) Implement adaptive eviction policy to avoid synchronized TTL expiries — size: medium (1 sprint) — owner: alex
4) Routing fallback: formalize model variant routing by tenant and load — size: large (2+ sprints, roadmap item) — owner: casey

samir: I also propose adding monitoring alert for TTL churn and per-tenant 5xx rate so we catch earlier. size: small — owner: samir

alex: Agree. Severity-based prioritization: since this caused customer-visible 504s, mark adaptive eviction as P0 for the upcoming sprint and routing fallback as Q3 roadmap epic.

priya: Product asks to tie adaptive eviction work into Q2 reliability OKR. Please include expected ROI and any perf/cost tradeoffs in the ticket.

oncall-bot: Incident mitigation closed at 2422223405 — no active pages for embedder-service.

alex: Action items to be created as a single remediation ticket with subtasks and sizing above. Labels: bug, sev2, remediation, backlog, q2-reliability. Please add owners and estimates in the ticket by EOD.

casey: I'll create the ticket (INF-4829) with the items and link to this thread + alert graphs. Will include a rough cost delta for fallback routing.

samir: I'll attach sampled traces and the TTL heatmap.

priya: Scheduling: let's do a 45m post-incident sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to review root cause and agree on acceptance criteria. Alex to own invite.

alex: Invite sent. Moving to post-incident/triage board. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

priya: Prioritization note — if we see recurrence within 2 weeks, escalate adaptive eviction work to immediate hotfix lane.

casey: Understood. Will add monitoring playbook and runbook updates as part of the small tasks.

samir: Thanks team. I'll follow up with a short impact summary to leadership after the 30m stability window.
